answer: What survives to the saffron is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The terrace holds work receipts rather than names, so the orchard of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
